columns.validationmsg: "Please enter valid value for Total Pieces"
columns.name: totalpieces

columns.validationmsg: "Bonus Qty Must be greater or Equal to Zero"
columns.name: bonusqty

columns.validationmsg: "Qty Must be greater or Equal to Zero"
columns.name: looseqty

table.retrieve:
SELECT
	item.customicode,
	srbufferdetail.alternatecustomicode,
	currlistrow = 0,
	icode = srbufferdetail.icode, 
	item.name,
	batch = srbufferdetail.batch, 
	expiry = srbufferdetail.expiry, 
	avgprice = srbufferdetail.avgprice,   
	newavgprice = srbufferdetail.newavgprice,   
	srbufferdetail.srbufferinvcode,    
	gcode =srbufferdetail.gcode,    
	packqty = srbufferdetail.packqty, 
	packunits = srbufferdetail.packunits, 
	srprice = srbufferdetail.srprice, 
	salestax = srbufferdetail.salestax, 
	salerowid = srbufferdetail.salerowid,
	stock = 0.0000, 
	currstock=srbufferdetail.currstock,
	packingdesc=space(50),
	totalstock = 0.0000, 
	retableqty = 0.0000, 
	saleqty =0.0000, 
	retablebonusqty = 0.0000, 
	salebonusqty =0.0000, 
	returnitemdescription=srbufferdetail.returnitemdescription,
	rowid = srbufferdetail.rowid,
	discperc = srbufferdetail.discperc,
	srutn = srbufferdetail.SrUtn,
	unitsalestax = srbufferdetail.unitsalestax,
	alternatepurprice = srbufferdetail.alternatepurprice,
	gstperc = srbufferdetail.gstperc,
	saleprice = srbufferdetail.saleprice,
	TotalPieces = srbufferdetail.TotalPieces,
	PiecesInHand = srbufferdetail.PiecesInHand,
	PackCapacity = item.PackCapacity,
	AreaVolume = item.AreaVolume,
	PCS=ROUND(srbufferdetail.looseqty / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6),
	Cartons= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(CAST(((ROUND(srbufferdetail.looseqty / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6)) / CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END) AS INT), 7, 0))) + ' : ' +
		LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(((CAST(ROUND(srbufferdetail.looseqty / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6) AS INT)) % CAST(CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END AS INT)), 7, 0))),
	Taxable = Item.Taxable,
	ItemAdvanceTaxPerc = srbufferdetail.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,
	bonusqty = srbufferdetail.bonusqty,
	looseqty = srbufferdetail.looseqty   
FROM 
	srbufferdetail,   
	item  
WHERE 
	( srbufferdetail.icode = item.icode ) and  
	(dbo.srbufferdetail.srbufferinvcode = :ra_salesretinvno )

objects.name: c_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum(( ( looseqty *  srprice  )  +   ( packqty *  srprice * packunits ) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )) for all )

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: trim(string(sum(long(left(cartons, pos( cartons , ':', 1) - 1))))) + ' : ' + trim(string(sum(long(mid(cartons, pos( cartons , ':', 1) + 1, len(cartons))))))

objects.name: c_itemtotal
objects.expression: (  ( looseqty *  srprice  )  +   ( packqty *  srprice * packunits ) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )  )
